mapper.insert: INSERT INTO participations (buncheol_id, buncheol_member_id, participant_id, shipping_address_id, type, instant_price_snapshot, bid_amount, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{buncheolId}, #{buncheolMemberId}, #{participantId}, #{shippingAddressId}, #{type}, #{instantPriceSnapshot}, #{bidAmount}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())

INSERT INTO participations (buncheol_id, buncheol_member_id, participant_id, shipping_address_id, type, instant_price_snapshot, bid_amount, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{buncheolId}, #{buncheolMemberId}, #{participantId}, #{shippingAddressId}, #{type}, #{instantPriceSnapshot}, #{bidAmount}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() FROM buncheols WHERE id = #{buncheolId} AND status = 'RECRUITING' AND deadline > NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, buncheol_id, buncheol_member_id, participant_id, shipping_address_id, type, instant_price_snapshot, bid_amount, balance_due_amount, balance_due_at, closed_rank, fail_reason, finalized_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM participations WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, buncheol_id, buncheol_member_id, participant_id, shipping_address_id, type, instant_price_snapshot, bid_amount, balance_due_amount, balance_due_at, closed_rank, fail_reason, finalized_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM participations WHERE buncheol_member_id = #{buncheolMemberId} AND participant_id = #{participantId} AND type = 'BID' AND status IN ('PAYMENT_PENDING', 'ACTIVE_BID')

SELECT id, buncheol_id, buncheol_member_id, participant_id, shipping_address_id, type, instant_price_snapshot, bid_amount, balance_due_amount, balance_due_at, closed_rank, fail_reason, finalized_at, status, created_at, updated_at FROM participations WHERE buncheol_member_id = #{buncheolMemberId} AND participant_id = #{participantId} AND status IN ('PAYMENT_PENDING', 'ACTIVE_BID', 'AWAITING_BALANCE_PAYMENT', 'CONFIRMED') LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM participations WHERE buncheol_member_id = #{buncheolMemberId} AND type = 'INSTANT' AND status IN ('PAYMENT_PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
mapper.update: UPDATE participations SET bid_amount = #{bidAmount}, shipping_address_id = #{shippingAddressId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND type = 'BID' AND status IN ('PAYMENT_PENDING', 'ACTIVE_BID')

UPDATE participations SET balance_due_amount = #{participation.balanceDueAmount}, balance_due_at = #{participation.balanceDueAt}, closed_rank = #{participation.closedRank}, fail_reason = #{participation.failReason}, finalized_at = #{participation.finalizedAt}, status = #{participation.status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{participation.id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE participations SET status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, finalized_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE buncheol_member_id = #{buncheolMemberId} AND type = 'BID' AND status IN ('PAYMENT_PENDING', 'ACTIVE_BID', 'AWAITING_BALANCE_PAYMENT')
